root_cause: Canonical learning and skill projection existed, but there was no generic deterministic mapping from a failure class to the lowest enforceable prevention mechanism, and no single obligation cockpit/metrics projection over canonical Brain truth.
prevention_rule: Every material failure must be compiled to the lowest machine-enforceable mechanism available and remain non-canonical until required replay/shadow/canary evaluation evidence exists. Operators consume one cockpit projection instead of reconstructing state from multiple stores.
